one_liner: Indian markets decline broadly with Nifty 50 down 1.11% amid rising volatility.

drivers.title: Broad Decline
drivers.detail: No specific catalyst identified for market decline.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 1,148.64 Cr; DIIs bought Rs 3,201.19 Cr.
watch_next: Wednesday's session includes GBP CPI data and BOE speech.
lesson_seeds: Market breadth was heavily negative with more declines than advances.
Financials and IT sectors led the decline in today's session.
Volatility increased significantly as indicated by the rise in India VIX.
No specific catalysts were identified for the top gainers and losers.
